title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We\'re hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical’s flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.

Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.

The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location : This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc)
  • Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning
  • Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Being an advocate of, and advancing, modern software development practices
  • Participating in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engaging with broader teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Travelling to internal and external global events for 4 to 6 weeks per year

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
  • Data Center infrastructure management and design

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we\'ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

Software Engineer Roles open at TideWise

TideWise's mission is to push the transition to a safer and more sustainable maritime industry. Many operations at sea actually do not require the physical presence of humans - they can perfectly be performed by uncrewed systems monitored by operators on shore. TideWise designs, builds and operates such systems, using its expertise with uncrewed vessels (USVs), and integrating the USVs with other types of robots or payloads (drones, ROVs). We are looking very broadly for engineers that can demonstrate understanding of multiple "sub-domains" relevant to our systems.

We\'re looking for experienced software developers, who are capable of demonstrating broad knowledge. We are not looking for deep specialists in a single domain. In any area or combination of areas that are relevant to TideWise\'s systems: networking, traditional frontend and backend roles, cloud infrastructure, reliability and diagnostics, robotics and machine learning. Experience with live systems that are world-facing (especially in the case of robotics) is a must.

You will be evaluated on both your past achievements and your ability to adapt.

We are normally working on site, with a couple of days per week from home (outside of exceptional situations). However, we will consider offering remote positions for exceptional candidates.

title: Local Mobiliser
description:
Overview

Result of Service
- The Local Mobiliser reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat’s operational and technical teams.
- Work Location
- Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
- Expected duration
- 2 months

Responsibilities

  • Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners, for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean - ROLAC - is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. UN-Habitat and the Municipality of Rio de Janeiro have a long history of working together, especially in the city's favelas and communities. To properly implement the UN-Habitat projects with the Municipality, a Local Mobiliser is required.
  • Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Local Mobiliser reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her.
  • Responsibilities The Local Mobiliser will support the implementation of the programme and its activities, with the following responsibilities:
    • a) Promote the participation and engagement of people living in the community.
    • b) Supporting the organisation and holding of meetings, workshops, assemblies and other spaces for social participation in the community.
    • c) Clearly and efficiently communicating project information to the community, ensuring that everyone is aware of project activities.
    • d) Promote active community participation in decision-making and project implementation, strengthening the sense of belonging.
    • e) Publicise the programme in the communities.
    • f) Attend project meetings whenever called upon.
    • g) Participate in local meetings as requested.
    • h) Be responsible, within its competencies, to ensure that the technical activities are aligned with the quality expectations of the Agency and the counterparts.
    • i) Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisors.
    • j) Elaboration and delivery of a Monthly Activity Report in a timely manner.
  • The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System.
  • Outputs/Work Assignment The Local Mobiliser will support the implementation of a project in partnership with the Municipality of Rio de Janeiro. The Local Mobiliser shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil of monthly activities’ report.

Qualifications / Special Skills

  • Education Required: Secondary school or additional two (2) years of relevant technical experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
  • Work experience: Minimum three (3) years of experience in the above-mentioned fields of work is required.
  • Experience in data collection, preferably in public projects and in vulnerable communities in Rio de Janeiro is required.
  • Experience in the social area and in coordinating fieldwork, preferably in the public sector and in vulnerable areas, is desirable.
  • Previous experience working in the United Nations is desirable.
  • Skills: Good computer skills in Windows and Office packages and Web search engines are required.
  • Previous experience in household, census and/or social surveys, especially in vulnerable areas is required.
  • Competencies: Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
  • Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of initiative and ability to work with limited supervision.

title: Associate Director, Clinical Biomarkers
description:
Overview

Nurix Therapeutics is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of targeted protein degradation medicines, the next frontier in innovative drug design aimed at improving treatment options for patients with cancer and inflammatory diseases. Powered by a fully AI-integrated discovery engine capable of tackling any protein class, and coupled with unparalleled ligase expertise, Nurix’s dedicated team has built a formidable advantage in translating the science of targeted protein degradation into clinical advancements. Nurix aims to establish degrader-based treatments at the forefront of patient care, writing medicine’s next chapter with a new script to outmatch disease.

The Position

The Associate Director of Clinical Biomarkers will play a pivotal role in advancing biomarker strategies to support the clinical development of Nurix’s innovative therapies targeting protein homeostasis. As a leader in the Clinical Biomarkers team, the successful candidate will collaborate across research, clinical development, and external partnerships to drive the biomarker strategy for early phase clinical trials. This role involves leading the design, execution, and interpretation of biomarker assays. These efforts will contribute to patient selection, pharmacodynamic assessments, and the elucidation of drug mechanisms of action.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development, validation, and execution of clinical biomarker strategies to inform patient stratification, response prediction, and resistance mechanisms across Nurix’s clinical programs.
  • Leverage deep expertise in cell and tumor biology, molecular biology, inflammation and immuno-oncology to design and interpret both preclinical and clinical biomarker studies.
  • Oversee biomarker assay development, including assay qualification and execution on diverse platforms, to support pharmacodynamic and predictive biomarker analysis in clinical trials.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of novel biomarker assays in both nonclinical models and patient-derived samples, ensuring alignment with clinical trial objectives.
  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams, including research scientists, clinical development, external collaborators, and contract research organizations (CROs), to ensure seamless integration of biomarker data into clinical development plans.
  • Provide scientific and strategic input into clinical trial designs, ensuring biomarker data are effectively utilized to guide therapeutic decisions and optimize patient outcomes.
  • Mentor and manage junior scientists, fostering a collaborative and innovative research environment.
  • Demonstrate strong motivation, creativity, and teamwork, with excellent time management and organizational skills.

Education And Skills Requirements

  • Advanced degree (M.S, Ph.D. preferred) with 8+ years of experience in a relevant scientific area within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry; candidates with a strong translational biomarker background in Immunology, Oncology, or Hematology are preferred.
  • Proven expertise in the development, qualification, and implementation of clinical biomarker assays, particularly in the areas of inflammation, immuno-oncology, cancer biology, or related therapeutic areas.
  • Extensive technical experience across diverse platforms, including flow cytometry, molecular biology, proteomics, and tissue-based assays; hands-on experience with clinical samples is a plus.
  • Demonstrated leadership in cross-functional teams, with a track record of integrating biomarker data to influence clinical decision-making.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex biomarker data to both scientific and clinical audiences, as well as external stakeholders.
  • Innovative mindset with a proactive approach to problem-solving and a strong motivation to drive scientific excellence in biomarker research.

Salary and Location

Salary Range: 205K – 232K
Location: Brisbane, CA - Onsite

title: Senior Manager, Customer Activation, BR
description:
Job Description Summary:

At The Coca-Cola Company, our purpose is to refresh the world and make a difference. We’re accelerating our momentum by putting people at the center of everything we do—bringing cutting-edge excellence in marketing, innovation, and activation to life in the market.

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Customer Activation to spearhead the strategy, execution, and optimization of integrated marketing and brand activation programs across customers and channels. This role will be accountable for leading high-impact initiatives that align with global brand strategies, translating Integrated Marketing Experience (IMX) plans into groundbreaking customer-facing activations. As a leader in this space, you will balance strategic oversight with tactical execution while fostering collaboration across teams to deliver measurable business growth, through customer innovation and market differentiation.

The ideal candidate is a dynamic leader, a creative thinker, and results-driven with a proven ability to guide multifunctional teams to deliver cutting-edge customer marketing programs. This position calls for an individual who is enthusiastic about elevating iconic brands in a complex and evolving marketplace.

What You’ll Do for Us

Strategic Ownership & Market Activation Leadership

  • Own and lead the overall development, implementation, and evaluation of innovative customer and channel activation programs that align with business priorities.

  • Drive the customization of global and regional marketing strategies into actionable customer and locally relevant activation plans.

  • Ensure deliverables exceed business objectives in volume, revenue, visibility, and brand equity, while adapting to the evolving requirements of customers and channels.

  • Anticipate market trends and align customer activation campaigns to optimize market agility and consumer relevance.

Integrated Marketing Leadership (IMX)

  • Steer seamless execution across all IMX touchpoints, including POS, packaging, promotions, experiential, digital, social, and local media, ensuring strategic integration and alignment with our broader marketing objectives.

  • Provide oversight and leadership over cross-functional teams, including Marketing, Shopper Marketing, IMX, Digital, Media, and Sales teams, uniting efforts to execute a consistent consumer and customer journey.

  • Actively champion the execution of fully integrated campaigns within company guidelines and communication frameworks, while innovating across traditional and non-traditional platforms.

Asset Optimization & Partnership Development

  • Lead large-scale activation projects leveraging global assets, sponsorships, and strategic partnerships, ensuring high-impact executions across multiple platforms (retail, on-premise, experiential, PR, and digital).

  • Maximize ROI by identifying opportunities to efficiently leverage internal and external assets while ensuring alignment with global branding strategies and standards.

  • Maintain a strong governance framework around asset policies, company guidelines, and legal and contractual requirements.

Agency and Vendor Leadership

  • Build robust partnerships with agency and supplier networks (creative, merchandising, promotions, etc.) to deliver best-in-class marketing support.

  • Develop comprehensive and actionable activation briefs, guiding agencies to produce innovative and high-impact solutions in alignment with objectives and metrics.

  • Drive vendor accountability through consistent management, ongoing feedback, and clear quality expectations.

Executional Excellence & Accountability

  • Champion excellence in execution, delivering activation plans on time, on budget, and with the highest quality across all touchpoints.

  • Continuously evaluate activation performance against KPIs to identify areas for optimization and ensure maximum effectiveness.

  • Implement a feedback loop to leverage data for decision-making and integrate learnings into future activation plans, constantly improving efficiency and impact.

Leadership in Governance & Brand Advocacy

  • Act as a trusted steward and champion for Coca-Cola brands by ensuring all activation materials (POS, packaging, promotions, etc.) comply with legal guidelines, internal policies, and brand protection standards.

  • Support frontline teams by ensuring all assets safeguard brand trademarks and equity, while enabling effective local customization.

People & Team Leadership Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic leadership to the team by connecting individual roles and responsibilities to broader organizational objectives, ensuring focus on delivering meaningful business growth.

  • Coach and mentor direct and cross-functional team members, building marketing acumen and project management capabilities for long-term success.

  • Foster an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performance culture, ensuring respect for diverse perspectives and driving a shared sense of accountability within the team.

  • Collaborate closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to influence strategic decision-making and implement impactful initiatives.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field (MBA preferred).

  • 8–12 years of experience in marketing activation, customer marketing, integrated marketing, or shopper marketing, including demonstrated leadership managing cross-functional teams and agencies in a matrixed organization.

  • Proven expertise transforming global and brand marketing strategies into action-oriented customer activations with measurable results.

  • Strong knowledge of integrated marketing principles, consumer and shopper marketing strategies, and the dynamics of channel/customer relationships.

  • Expertise in delivering excellence across IMX touchpoints, with sound project management skills and agile responsiveness in fast-moving environments.

  • A history of successfully leading external partners (agencies, suppliers) with a focus on executional quality, disciplined budget management, and creative problem-solving.

  • Exceptional ability to influence and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders while demonstrating strong executive presence.

  • Fluent in English, with additional language skills highly regarded.

What We’ll Do for You

  • Strategic Impact: Lead the way in reimagining customer and channel-oriented brand activation strategies that elevate Coca-Cola's powerful portfolio of global brands.

  • Leadership Growth: Develop your leadership skills through cross-functional engagements and high-impact responsibilities across multiple touchpoints and channels.

  • Career Expansion: Opportunities to excel in IMX leadership and marketing strategy roles, and a clear pathway to Director-level growth within The Coca-Cola Company.

  • Professional Development: Access marketing resources, industry-leading tools, and on-demand development experiences tailored to accelerate your career trajectory.

  • Purposeful Engagement: Contribute to The Coca-Cola Company’s mission of fostering communities, driving sustainability, and creating better futures for people worldwide.

description:
Descrição da vaga

A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com o propósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil. Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente. Nosso ecossistema tecnológico é robusto, baseado em sistemas core de alta complexidade (Solus como ERP, Tasy como Prontuário Eletrônico e Salesforce como plataforma central de CRM e Atendimento), todos integrados por um moderno Barramento de Serviços na AWS seguindo a arquitetura API-LED.

O que nos move:

  • Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.
  • Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.
  • Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.
  • Como fazemos isso:
  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.
  • Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.
  • Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

A responsabilidade envolve promover e garantir a saúde e segurança dos colaboradores por meio da implementação, monitoramento e melhoria contínua das práticas de Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho (SST). Este profissional atuará na identificação de riscos, desenvolvimento de ações preventivas, cumprimento da legislação vigente e apoio às áreas internas, sendo desejável experiência prévia no setor de saúde suplementar (operadoras de planos de saúde, clínicas, hospitais ou empresas do segmento).

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar inspeções em ambientes, instalações e equipamentos, identificando condições inseguras e propondo ações preventivas.
  • Elaborar, implementar e acompanhar programas de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho, como PGR, LTCAT, AET , entre outros.
  • Investigar e analisar acidentes e incidentes, identificando causas e propondo medidas corretivas e preventivas.
  • Conduzir treinamentos de segurança, integrações, DDS (Diálogo Diário de Segurança) e campanhas educativas de prevenção.
  • Controlar, orientar e fiscalizar o uso correto de EPIs e EPCs .
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos, indicadores e estatísticas de acidentes, acompanhando resultados e planos de ação.
  • Acompanhar perícias, auditorias e fiscalizações, prestando suporte técnico e emitindo CAT quando necessário.
  • Manter atualizada a documentação legal e os registros obrigatórios de SST.
  • Apoiar ações relacionadas à ergonomia, saúde ocupacional e prevenção de riscos psicossociais.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho completo.
  • Registro ativo no MTE .
  • Conhecimento e domínio das Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) e investigação de acidentes.
  • Experiência com gestão de riscos e programas de SST (PGR/GRO ).
  • Conhecimento em legislação trabalhista, previdenciária, RDC e normas de Vigilância Sanitária .
  • Domínio do Pacote Office .
  • Experiência com sistemas de gestão de SST.
  • Experiência prévia na área da saúde suplementar será considerada um diferencial importante.

Salário: pretensão

description:
Analista de Comportamento e Experiência do Consumidor | Marketing

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Somos uma área estratégica responsável por transformar dados em decisões. Atuamos na análise de performance de campanhas e eventos, no desenvolvimento de soluções de Business Intelligence e na geração de insights sobre comportamento, jornada e experiência do consumidor, apoiando a liderança na tomada de decisões.

A área tem forte interface com tecnologia, dados e negócios, sendo responsável por relatórios executivos, dashboards e estudos analíticos sobre comportamento e jornada do consumidor, que impactam diretamente os resultados da companhia.

  • Analisar interações do consumidor com diferentes iniciativas da companhia (CRM, benefícios, promoções, eventos e ações de marketing);
  • Gerar insights estratégicos a partir de dados, apoiando decisões táticas e executivas;
  • Evoluir dashboards e relatórios gerenciais no Power BI;
  • Monitorar KPIs, garantindo qualidade, consistência e leitura crítica dos dados;
  • Conduzir análises e estudos sobre comportamento, jornada e experiência do consumidor, identificando padrões, oportunidades e pontos de melhoria;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento e evolução de indicadores de experiência do consumidor (ex.: NPS, satisfação e engajamento);
  • Conduzir estudos de mercado, análises de tendências e benchmarking;
  • Estruturar análises, relatórios executivos e apresentações para a diretoria.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, raciocínio lógico e pensamento estruturado;
  • Domínio avançado de Power BI (mandatório), incluindo modelagem de dados, DAX e dashboards interativos;
  • Conhecimento sólido em Excel e Pacote Office;
  • Habilidade para cruzar diferentes bases de dados e transformar informação em insights.
  • Boa comunicação para apresentar análises a diferentes públicos;
  • Interesse por comportamento do consumidor, experiência e jornada do cliente;
  • Experiência em varejo ou shopping centers será um diferencial.

Descrição da vaga

A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com o propósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil . Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente.

O que nos move:

  • Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.
  • Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.
  • Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.

Como fazemos isso:

  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.
  • Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.
  • Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

Somos uma empresa em constante crescimento, e cada colaborador é parte essencial dessa construção. Aqui dentro, acreditamos em colaboração, em diálogo e no poder de fazer diferente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Receber os pacientes com empatia, cordialidade e atenção desde a chegada à clínica;
  • Realizar o acolhimento inicial, identificando necessidades e oferecendo suporte personalizado;
  • Orientar sobre procedimentos, horários, documentos e fluxo da clínica;
  • Esclarecer dúvidas sobre consultas, exames, encaminhamentos e demais serviços;
  • Realizar autorização de guias junto a operadoras de saúde (via sistemas como TISS ou plataformas específicas);
  • Efetuar o recebimento de atendimentos particulares, incluindo emissão de recibos e controle de pagamentos;
  • Acompanhar o paciente durante sua jornada, garantindo conforto e tranquilidade;
  • Após a consulta, verificar como foi a experiência e oferecer suporte adicional, se necessário;
  • Atuar como ponte entre paciente e equipe médica/administrativa, promovendo comunicação clara;
  • Receber e organizar documentos, correspondências e resultados de exames;
  • Auxiliar em tarefas administrativas como preenchimento de fichas, arquivamento e atualização de cadastros;
  • Manter a recepção limpa, organizada e funcional.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo (superior em áreas da saúde, humanas ou hospitalidade é um diferencial);
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escuta ativa;
  • Postura acolhedora, empática e proativa;
  • Experiência com atendimento ao público, preferencialmente em ambientes de saúde;
  • Capacidade de lidar com situações delicadas com sensibilidade e discrição.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com atendimento humanizado;
  • Conhecimento do sistema Tasy;
  • Conhecimento básico em sistemas de gestão ambulatorial;
  • Participação em treinamentos de hospitalidade ou experiência do cliente.

  • Atuar em fóruns internos e externos, conectando‑se com liderança local, regional e global.

Por que VOCÊ?

Suas qualificações

  • Formação Superior Completo, preferencialmente em Administração, Engenharia, Estatística, Economia ou Ciência de Dados.
  • Mínimo de 5 anos em Produtividade de Vendas, Inteligência Comercial, BI, RGM preferencialmente em FMCG.
  • Pelo menos 3 anos em posição de liderança;
  • Pacote Office Avançado;

  • Capacidade de gestão de projetos e organização;
  • Experiência prévia em Planejamento Comercia e RGM em empresas de consumo;
  • Inglês Avançado.

Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão

Na Haleon, vamos além das expectativas e impulsionamos uma cultura em que fazemos o que mais importa. Promovemos um ambiente onde a diversidade seja celebrada, a equidade seja praticada e a inclusão seja vivenciada.

Nosso compromisso é humanizar as relações, respeitando à individualidade e garantindo que cada colaborador sinta‑se valorizado, incluído e parte essencial de nossa comunidade.

title: Gerente Regional de Investigações Antifalsificação (América)
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Sobre a Função

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gerente Regional de Investigações Antifalsificação para integrar nossa equipe global de Group Security. A posição reporta-se ao(à) Líder Global de Antifalsificação (ACF) e tem como objetivo liderar a estratégia regional de combate à falsificação, protegendo nossa marca, nossos consumidores e nossa propriedade intelectual.

Esta é uma oportunidade para profissionais que desejam atuar em um ambiente diverso, colaborativo e com impacto real nos negócios, trabalhando em parceria com equipes internas, autoridades e parceiros externos em diferentes países da região.

Base: Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo

Principais Responsabilidades

Liderança Estratégica

  • Colaborar com áreas internas como negócios, jurídico, assuntos corporativos e comunicação
  • Construir e manter parcerias com autoridades, entidades do setor e stakeholders estratégicos
  • Gerenciar fornecedores de serviços de investigação, promovendo eficiência, inovação e uso responsável do orçamento
  • Definir indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e acompanhar resultados
  • Comunicar avanços e insights de forma clara à liderança e às partes interessadas

Execução Operacional

  • Identificar mercados, produtos e riscos prioritários na região
  • Implementar estratégias regionais de antifalsificação alinhadas aos objetivos globais
  • Supervisionar investigações online e offline realizadas por parceiros externos
  • Desenvolver inteligência sobre tendências, rotas e novos métodos de falsificação
  • Atuar em conjunto com autoridades, alfândega e órgãos reguladores em ações de enforcement
  • Garantir conformidade com legislações internacionais de propriedade intelectual
  • Apoiar iniciativas legais relacionadas à falsificação
  • Gerenciar o orçamento regional do programa de antifalsificação
  • Avaliar resultados e ajustar estratégias quando necessário
  • Trabalhar com equipes de embalagem e negócio na adoção de tecnologias de autenticação de produtos

Engajamento e Desenvolvimento

  • Gerenciar o relacionamento com fornecedores externos de investigação
  • Desenvolver treinamentos regionais sobre riscos e prevenção à falsificação
  • Representar a Haleon em fóruns, eventos e grupos de trabalho do setor
  • Atuar como referência técnica para stakeholders internos na região

Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida (mín. 5 anos) em investigações, proteção de marca, antifalsificação ou enforcement de propriedade intelectual
  • Vivência com autoridades, alfândega e equipes jurídicas em contextos internacionais ou regionais
  • Experiência na gestão de investigações complexas e fornecedores externos
  • Conhecimento em leis de propriedade intelectual e tendências de falsificação
  • Certificações na área são um diferencial
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita
  • Ética, resiliência e senso de responsabilidade
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório)

Competências Essenciais

  • Autonomia, organização e tomada de decisão responsável
  • Capacidade de atuar tanto de forma estratégica quanto prática
  • Habilidade para trabalhar com múltiplos stakeholders e equipes diversas
  • Experiência em gestão de orçamento e fornecedores
  • Mentalidade orientada a risco, aprendizado contínuo e melhoria constante
  • Capacidade de colaborar com pessoas de diferentes culturas, países e realidades

About the Role

As part of a global team within Group Security, the Anti-Counterfeit Regional Investigations Manager reports to the Global Lead for Anti-Counterfeiting (ACF). The main function of the role is to tactically develop and implement the ACF strategy, manage and supervise ACF Program investigations and activities in the designated geographic region to include country specific plans. Responsibilities include intelligence assessment, case selection, the management and oversight of anti-counterfeit investigations (online and offline), proactive investigation case management, to include the development and implementation of innovative approaches and investigative strategies to meet business needs.

The manager will collaborate with internal business stakeholders, law enforcement, legal teams, and external partners to drive enforcement actions and strategic initiatives. The role ensures the protection of the company’s intellectual property, brand integrity, and consumer trust by identifying, investigating, and mitigating counterfeit activities.

Location: Rio de Janeiro or Sao Paulo

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop operational relationships with key internal stakeholders including business, legal, corporate affairs, and corporate communications
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with law enforcement agencies, industry bodies, regulatory authorities, and peer organizations
  • Build and maintain strategic and tactical investigation service supplier relationships, promoting innovation, responsiveness, cost optimization, return on investment (ROI), and continuous improvement
  • Develop KPIs and reporting frameworks to measure program effectiveness and return on investment (ROI)
  • Provide regular updates to senior leadership and stakeholders

Operational Execution

  • Conduct risk assessments to identify high-risk markets and products
  • Develop and implement regional anti-counterfeit strategies aligned with global brand protection goals
  • Provide instruction and guidance to external investigation suppliers based on the strategic direction set by the Global Program Lead
  • Provide effective case management oversight and direction by working with external investigation suppliers to ensure investigations are conducted and reported efficiently and in accordance with Haleon’s ACF Program Strategy
  • Develop intelligence strategies to identify and monitor counterfeiting trends
  • Oversee regional monitoring of counterfeit activities across online and offline channels
  • Implement a regional customs strategy to identify key strategic ports and counterfeiting routes, product authentication training opportunities, and intelligence dissemination practices
  • Coordinate with law enforcement, customs, regulatory bodies, and industry coalitions to pursue and, when appropriate attend, enforcement actions
  • Ensure ACF Program compliance with international IP laws and regulations
  • Support litigation efforts related to counterfeit activities
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of counterfeit trends and regulatory changes
  • Manage the regional anti-counterfeit program budget, ensuring effective forecasting, spend control, and ROI
  • Monitor and evaluate enforcement outcomes and adjust strategies accordingly
  • Identify and report counterfeiting developments and techniques which undermine product security
  • Work with packaging design and business teams to evaluate and implement product authentication technologies (e.g., serialization, digital watermarking, blockchain).

Stakeholder Engagement and Training

  • Manage relationships with external investigation service suppliers
  • Develop regional training programs to educate stakeholders on counterfeiting risks and mitigation opportunities
  • Represent Haleon at regional industry forums, conferences and working groups to share intelligence, benchmark practices, and influence standards
  • As a subject matter expert, support a regional network of non-ACF champions embedded across business units and functions

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in law enforcement investigations, brand protection, anti-counterfeiting, or IP enforcement
  • Experience of working with law enforcement, customs, and legal teams across international jurisdictions
  • Proven experience in investigating and managing complex proactive investigations and enforcements
  • Demonstrated success in managing third-party investigation service suppliers and operational budgets
  • Professional certification such as Interpol Intellectual Property (IP) Crime College or recognized university anti-counterfeit or intellectual property program accreditation strongly preferred
  • Strong understanding of IP laws, counterfeit trends, and enforcement mechanisms
  • Exceptional written/oral communication
  • High ethical standards, discretion, and resilience under pressure

Core Competencies

  • Self-motivated and able to act independently and responsibly demonstrating sound and ethical judgment
  • Ability, at both a strategic and tactical level, to identify and manage ACF related issues and customize, implement, and execute solutions
  • Strong commercial acumen and budget/vendor management experience
  • Risk-based thinking and continuous improvement
  • Stakeholder engagement
  • Demonstrate ability to work with a wide range of individuals from diverse backgrounds, countries of origin, and at varying levels within the corporate structure

Job Posting End Date

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Adjustment or Accommodations Request

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

Note to candidates

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Promotor de Merchandising – Limppano – Rio de Janeiro
description:
Promotor de Merchandising – Limppano – Rio de Janeiro

Responsabilidades e atribuições

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:

  • Reposição de Produtos: abastecer o ponto natural da categoria (gôndolas) e pontos extras negociados ou conquistados (ilhas, terminais, pontas de gôndolas, “orelhas”, entre outros) de acordo com as diretrizes da Limppano, evitando rupturas e respeitando o FIFO (primeiro que vence é o primeiro que sai).
  • Exposição e Organização: garantir que os produtos estejam organizados e alinhados com o planograma da empresa.
  • Montagem de Pontos Extras: instalar materiais promocionais (MPDV) e montar exposições sazonais, campanhas e ações promocionais.
  • Precificação: verificar e corrigir preços nos produtos e nas gôndolas conforme as informações da loja ou da empresa. Implementar as etiquetas de preços no PDV.
  • Controle de Estoque: Acompanhar o estoque na área de vendas e no depósito do PDV para evitar falta ou excesso de mercadoria.
  • Negociação de Espaços: conquistar espaços extras através de negociação com o gerente ou responsável pelo setor da loja, buscando melhor visibilidade para os produtos.
  • Coleta de Informações: realizar (via aplicativo Involves) pesquisas de preço, presença de produtos, espaço em gôndola, implementação de MPDV, abertura de caixas, ações da concorrência, condições de exposição, entre outros, de acordo com a necessidade do momento (informações da Limppano e da concorrência).
  • Relatórios e Feedbacks: registrar evidências (fotos e informações) das execuções e enviar relatórios diários através do aplicativo Involves.
  • Relacionamento: conquistar e manter um bom relacionamento com o time de loja para facilitar as operações e execuções.
  • Sugestão de Transferências: realizar sugestão de transferência de mercadoria do Centro de Distribuição (CD) para as lojas.

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS:

  • Formação: ensino médio completo. Desejável formação técnica ou superior em andamento (Marketing, Administração, Logística, etc).
  • Experiência: vivência anterior como Promotor de Vendas no setor de limpeza será um diferencial.

Condições de Trabalho

  • Atuação externa com visitas a diferentes PDVs diariamente, seguindo a sistemática pré-determinada.
  • Trabalho físico leve a moderado (carga, movimentação e organização de produtos).
  • Eventual necessidade de deslocamento entre cidades da região.
